title: What it requires of the organisation
caption: The workflow people draw takes the shape of the organisation.
board: Above, the venue team of ten and Food and drinks of one, drawn as dashed team boxes; below, the four cards Activities, Travel, Venue, Food and drinks chained to the goal, their seams following the goal, not the teams

from-people-to-the-company.title: From people to the company
from-people-to-the-company.script: Skills in your people are not enough. The workflow they draw has a shape of its own, and that shape comes from the organisation they work in.
